item.title: Data center project portal launches for northwest Louisiana
item.description: The Bossier Parish Police Jury announced that the official landing page for the new data center project in northwest Louisiana is now live. The website, SBCdatacenter.com, currently serves as a registration portal for local businesses and service providers interested in potential future opportunities connected to the project. item.title: Port of Caddo Bossier selected for Louisiana FastSites Program
item.description: The Port of Caddo Bossier has been named one of 19 sites across 16 parishes to advance in Louisiana’s inaugural FastSites program, a first-of-its-kind state initiative to prepare industrial sites for high-impact projects.
